layers.name: CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION
layers.text: Components that exist in the repository today and their data interfaces. Only the Stage-1 combination was ever run online (see HISTORICAL EXPERIMENT); this is not a validated production pipeline.

layers.name: HISTORICAL EXPERIMENT - Stage 1 (ACT checkpoint ranking with WM3-B)
layers.text: The flow of the Stage-1 pilot: three ACT checkpoint chunks ranked by a frozen score of WM3-B predictions. Development evidence; ranking did not show an overall success improvement.

layers.name: HISTORICAL / DESIGN - G2a / G2b grasp correction
layers.text: Geometric correction candidates of the ACT chunk executed from a snapshot; NO world model is involved. G2a executed (outcome claims invalidated); G2b is design + integration self-tests only.

nodes.label: Camera observation + joint state
nodes.purpose: Policy inputs: three camera images and the 16-D joint state of the actuated joints. Ground truth (box pose, contacts) is a separate evaluation-only channel.
outputs: state: (16,) float32 = qpos of the actuated joints (left j1-7, left finger, right j1-7, right finger)
limitations: Privileged `info` channel must never reach the policy.
Camera intrinsics partly unverified (head camera spec from memory, see sim/cameras.py).

nodes.label: ACT policy
nodes.purpose: Imitation policy trained on scripted-expert demonstrations; produces a 20-step action chunk from the current observation.
nodes.shapes_verified: ChunkPolicy asserts (20,16); config chunk_size = n_action_steps = 20, use_vae False
nodes.model_type: ACT transformer (LeRobot ACTPolicy), deterministic at inference
limitations: Stateless chunk wrapper: no action queue, no temporal ensembling.
Single-seed training; between-train variance unknown.
Unseen-pose success 18/30 in the V1 audit.

nodes.label: Action chunk (20x16)
nodes.purpose: Absolute joint-position targets for the next 20 control steps (dt = 0.05 s) in actuator order; gripper unit is metres.
limitations: Open loop within a chunk.

nodes.label: Candidate generation (checkpoint ensemble)
nodes.purpose: Stage 1: three ACT checkpoints c0_s0, c0_s1, c0_s2 each produce one candidate chunk.
limitations: Candidates differ only by training seed / statistics.

nodes.label: WM3-B dynamics
nodes.purpose: Predict future box and contact evolution for a candidate action sequence from privileged simulator state.
nodes.shapes_verified: eval/closed_loop_pilot.py build_window and eval/wm3b_model.py GRUOC (code reading); output tensor shapes are not asserted by tests
limitations: Depends on privileged simulator state (box pose, contact forces).
Independent evaluation: calibration gate G3 FAIL.
Offline error numbers are not task success.

nodes.label: Future state prediction
nodes.purpose: Predicted box and contact trajectories over K = 20 steps for every candidate.
limitations: Short horizon; not calibrated for decisions (G3).

nodes.label: Candidate scoring
nodes.purpose: Frozen score J combining predicted box displacement and contact terms; lower is better.
limitations: Defined before the pilot; local correctness only.

nodes.label: Action selection
nodes.purpose: A0: default checkpoint; A1: random among the three; A2: argmin of the WM3-B score.
limitations: A2 vs A1 and A2 vs A0 are INCONCLUSIVE (intervals contain 0).

nodes.label: Grasp-correction candidates
nodes.purpose: ACT raw chunk -> remove gravity-comp offset -> FK -> geometric correction in the box frame -> IK -> absolute targets. G2a: 9 candidates; G2b: 7 (c0, O1, O3, D1, D2, H1, S0).
limitations: O1 and O3 use the TRUE box pose (oracle) and are not deployable.
No world model is used in this flow.

nodes.label: Safety / action adapter
nodes.purpose: Rejects NaN / wrong shape, clips to ctrlrange and limits the slew rate before every command reaches the simulator.
limitations: Slew limits are simulation-tuned; real-robot limits are not validated.

nodes.label: MuJoCo OpenArm v1
nodes.purpose: Physics: OpenArm v1 bimanual model in the lab scene; 20 Hz control with 50 substeps of 1 ms.
limitations: Upstream OpenArm model files are not modified.
Simulation only.

nodes.label: Event-based outcome labeller (G2b)
nodes.purpose: Turns a per-finger trace into events, one terminal outcome and E1 / E2 / E3 (TRUE / FALSE / CENSORED / INVALID) with ambiguity flags.
inputs: trace: g_exec, g_meas, nL, nR, FL, FR, box pose / velocity
limitations: Validated on synthetic cases and integration self-tests only; independent blind annotation not run.
Contract r3 is a freeze candidate, not frozen.

nodes.label: S0 time-shift control
nodes.purpose: Holds the last executed target for 8 steps, resets policy state, resumes ACT: a pure schedule shift used as a timing control.
nodes.shapes_verified: integration gate I3 (k = 0 equals nominal exactly)
limitations: May genuinely change the physics, so non-equivalence does not by itself prove label timing bias.
